about_the_game:
Game Introduction

Lane, a carefree girl living in the Mangrove City of Celeste, went on a trip with her friends as usual during the summer vacation. However, she met a black-clad man who claimed to be looking for the Omega seal and a woman called "Cardinal". In the pursuit of the truth, what kind of sparks will be ignited between them, and what will Lane do? Everything is up to you to decide. . .

Story background

The story of "FALL" takes place in a fictional world called "Vision Land". The world of "Vision Land" was once very similar to our real world until the discovery of Ether energy led to the outbreak of war. After the war, a political pattern that lasted for a hundred years emerged. It seems that there is a mysterious hand keeping the world unchanged, forcibly stopping time.

Character Introduction

Lane

The girl living in Mangrove, a port city in Celeste, has led a carefree life since childhood. Perhaps because her past life was carefree, stable and peaceful, she developed a calm personality, without desires or attachments. However, fate will push her down a perilous path.

Zemots

Lane's classmate, a young man who once developed feelings for her. Born with a melancholic personality, they often appear listless.

Amber

Lane's classmate, a hot-tempered and energetic girl, is lively but a bit hard to get along with.

Kresodore

Lane's classmate is a very influential figure in the school. Coming from a wealthy family, he has a domineering personality and attaches great importance to the concept of hierarchy. He likes to divide people into different classes and strives to become the "upper class" in his mind. Such a personality makes him pursue what doesn't belong to him.

Lambda

Senior officials of the mysterious organization seem to use Lambda as their code name. This time I came to Mangrove City to recruit candidates for the "Omega of Cardinals".

Alpha

The leader of the mysterious organization.

Gameplay

The total text volume is 50,000 words, divided into the prologue, Chapter One, Chapter Two and Chapter Three. There are two different endings. Players will make a choice at a key node and it will affect the direction of the ending.

In addition to the main storyline, there will also be very detailed explanations of various Settings in the visual field.

It does not include a favorability system. Except for the protagonist Lane, the plots of the others are fixed.

After encountering members of a mysterious organization , she will go to investigate a series of mysterious events. Depending on the player's choice, the game will lead to two different endings.
